description:
Make Distiller Fast finding 2: `:erlang.is_function(f, 2)` is refused in a guard ("entry guards are not dispatch-pure"); Elixir accepts it.

Callables (by reading the code, not by running it): CallableName::from_expr (src/ast/mod.rs:75-118) has no arm for an atom module, so `:erlang.f` resolves to nothing; lib/erlang.fz has no is_function. Scope: call resolution plus the library clause. Not absorbed by option C (https://claude.ai/artifact/HJ4StaQ4ggt6yt2Fus6pX7).

Check against fz-mue.5 (#833, :erlang exports the BIFs json.erl calls), which already routes :erlang calls in bodies.
title: :erlang.f resolves to the Erlang module, and lib/erlang.fz gains is_function/1,2
